headline: Recruitment Specialist
summary: Customer service representative of three years who moved into recruitment at the same BPO. For the past year I have screened applicants by phone, coordinated interview days and helped new hires through their first weeks. I bring a CSR's patience and phone manner to every candidate call.

projects.name: Walk-in hiring day redesign
bullets: Reorganised the Saturday walk-in hiring day so applicants finish the initial interview, assessment and account interview in one visit.
Average waiting time for applicants dropped from four hours to under two.

projects.name: Referral drive
projects.description: Ran a two-month employee referral drive among agents that brought in 70 qualified applicants.

experience.title: Recruitment Specialist
bullets: Screen 40 to 60 applicants a day by phone for voice and chat accounts.
Coordinate assessment and interview schedules with operations and training.
Help new hires with documents and questions in their first two weeks.

experience.title: Customer Service Representative (Voice)
bullets: Handled about 70 calls a day for a US telecom account, keeping satisfaction scores above target for 11 straight months.
Logged every interaction in the client's CRM and followed up open cases.
Mentored new agents on the floor during their nesting period.
